about: Lines the NPC output check must still reject, each with the category it must report (issue #526).
'context_free' lines fail with no scenario context. 'by_scenario' lines say part of that scenario's NPC hidden agenda aloud
and fail only against it: services/convsim-core/tests/test_output_check_corpora.py loads the agenda and public brief from the pack.
The category is the one the check must report (a line may also trip others). Never remove a line or change its category to make a change pass: see docs/safety-policy.md, 'Changing a pattern'.
